provenance.notes: Generated mixed-format dataset used for scaling, calibration, and tuning checks.

split_definitions.train: Synthetic nominal runs used for model fitting.
split_definitions.calibration: Synthetic nominal runs used for threshold calibration.
split_definitions.nominal_eval: Synthetic held-out nominal runs used for false-positive inspection.
split_definitions.anomalous_eval: Synthetic abnormal runs with injected disturbances used for evaluation.

data_quality_issues: Synthetic signals do not establish operational detection performance.
Runtime and workflow findings are more trustworthy than metric quality.
